facts.fact: The World Bank report says the National Identification Agency (NIDA) is the permanent agency in charge of both the national ID and civil registration and is itself launching the digital birth registration system, with the Ministry of Local Government the authority for enacting and monitoring birth registration; no date is given for the statement, so the document's publication year is used.

The World Bank report says a new digital birth registration system is about to be rolled out by NIDA, allowing new births to be registered at health centres or at Cell offices; the report covers births only and the system was not yet in use at fieldwork (November 2019 to January 2020).

As designed, per the World Bank report, a health-centre data manager enters the birth and the head nurse completes the registration in the system at discharge, issuing the baby a national identification number, the process being paperless; for a home birth the Cell office registers it and issues the number; this describes the planned process, not one in operation, and is dated to the document's publication year.

The World Bank report says birth registration currently takes place at the civil registrar offices of the Sectors (416 Sectors, 2,148 Cells) and that the digital birth registration system for health centres and Cell offices is about to be rolled out, so no office was yet using it at fieldwork (November 2019 to January 2020).

systems.tiers: planned for health centres and hospitals (data manager and head nurse) and Cell offices; not yet rolled out at publication; registration until then at Sector civil registrar offices
national electronic register, launched 2008, said to hold about 98 percent of the population; since 2016 NIDA receives birth and death data electronically for a record to be created or flagged in it

systems.system: national ID card and national identification number (NIN)
systems.tiers: applications and biometric capture at Sector offices equipped with biometric data collection kits; 16-digit number; the new birth registration is to issue the NIN at birth
web portal and agents nationwide; payment for and issue of the three kinds of birth certificate, all three available through it at publication; ID application fee payment

systems.country_label: civil registrar book / civil registries kept at Sector offices
systems.owner: Sector civil registrar, under the Ministry of Local Government
systems.tiers: 416 Sector offices and embassies; the report does not say how the Sector record is made, and recommends that old civil registration records may need digitising
